note: Einzelne Parasaurolophus sind meist Hirsche, die verstoßen wurden oder neue Bindungen suchen und laut rufend umherziehen. Das ist der Rothirsch allein, die Herdenführung der Wildpferde fällt größtenteils weg.

analogs.covers: Solo stag: a lone, calling stag roaming between herds in search of new bonds
Herd memory: the ancestral routes it still follows, and the herd discipline that may have shunned it

solo.headline: A lone red stag on the move: shunned or searching, he roams the ancestral routes and calls across open ground until another herd answers.
solo.playsLike: Solitary Parasaurolophus are rare, and almost always stags who travel alone for a while, recently shunned from a herd or looking for new bonds. On open ground you call loudly, hoping to hear other herds echo back, either to reconnect with old herd mates or to find new ones. Alone you flee every Apex carnivore, and when attacked you keep fleeing or turn defensive. Herds take in strangers readily: does and stags even adopt orphans, young Iguanodon and Lambeosaurus and lone Barsboldia.

why.text: Some individuals, “most notably stags”, travel alone, “especially if recently shunned from a herd, or in search of new bonds”. Red deer stags live apart from the hinds outside the rut.
Loners “are highly vocal when in open ground, hoping to hear their calls echoed back by others”, like a stag roaring across a valley.
It keeps travelling the long generational loops, as wild horses keep to the paths their herd taught them.
Apex tier and 1,400 HP, yet alone it always flees Apex carnivores or turns defensive when caught.

notLike: Red deer stags are quiet outside the rut; a lone Parasaurolophus calls constantly to find a herd.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein einzelner Rothirsch auf Wanderschaft, fast immer ein Hirsch, der aus einer Herde verstoßen wurde oder neue Bindungen sucht. Du ziehst die alten Wanderrouten entlang und rufst auf offenem Gelände laut, damit dir andere Herden antworten, ob alte Herdengenossen oder neue. Vor Apex-Räubern fliehst du allein immer, und wirst du angegriffen, fliehst du weiter oder wehrst dich. Herden nehmen Fremde gern auf, also ist dein Alleinsein meist nur eine Phase.
